macro_context.market_sentiment: Strongly bullish: S&P 500 +1.10% to ~7,339, Nasdaq +1.36% to ~25,670, Dow +1.14% to ~49,854 as of May 6, 2026, all near record highs. Rally driven by progress toward a U.S.-Iran diplomatic deal easing oil prices, and strong earnings from AMD and tech.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates at 3.50-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (third consecutive hold) with an unusual 8-4 dissent split — three officials opposed retaining future-cut language, while one Trump appointee (Miran) favored an immediate cut. Powell remains on the Board. Inflation elevated partly from energy prices; cuts remain uncertain near-term.
macro_context.geopolitical: U.S.-Iran conflict is the dominant driver: oil prices are elevated but easing on ceasefire/deal hopes. Secondary risks include U.S. tariff uncertainty, NATO posture in Greenland, and U.S. intervention in Venezuela. These risks weighed on markets earlier in April but sentiment has improved materially in May.
